ci.read_attributes(tag) returns HDF5 attributes as a dict, ci.read_text(tag) returns

restart any clio runtime or server, and do not read the data from anywhere else.
If you cannot connect, stop and report the error.

Task: regenerate Figure 10 of the paper (the pointwise likelihood ratio over the
space of standard candle luminosity functions, with the electromagnetic source
classes marked) from the posterior stored in clio-core.

1. fig10.py - the script, reading all data and parameters from clio-core.
2. fig10.png - the regenerated Figure 10.
3. answer.md - how the figure was computed (template, parameters, contour levels),

   how fig10.png compares with Figure 10 in the paper, and how long reading the data
